title: Reports
content: Reports is your central hub for generating and exporting operational data — monthly KPI snapshots, critical alert history, LN2 refill records, and full audit trails across all your branches.

title: Open Reports
content: Click here to open the Reports page.

title: Report Filters
content: Use these filters to scope your report before generating it — select a branch, set a date range, and pick the report type that matches your audit or review goal.

title: Monthly Summary Report
content: Monthly Summary gives you a KPI-level breakdown for a selected calendar month — showing how many alerts were triggered and how many deviations were detected for each parameter across your tanks.

title: Month Filter
content: Pick the month you want to review. The results table updates immediately — no submit button needed.

title: Monthly Summary — Results
content: Each row maps a KPI configuration to the total alerts sent and deviations detected for that month. Use this to identify which parameters triggered the most incidents and which areas need attention.

title: Critical Alert Report
content: Critical Alerts Report lists every alert triggered across your tanks within a date range. Filter by status, severity, or specific tank codes to drill into the incidents that need attention.

title: Date From
content: Set the start of your date range. Only alerts that occurred on or after this date will appear in the results.

title: Date To
content: Set the end of your date range. Use Date From and Date To together to isolate a specific incident window.

title: Status Filter
content: Filter by alert status — Active alerts are still open and unaddressed; Acknowledged means a team member has reviewed and confirmed them.

title: Severity Filter
content: Narrow results to High, Medium, or Low severity. High severity alerts indicate an immediate risk to tank conditions and require urgent action.

title: Tank Codes Filter
content: Select one or more tank codes to see only alerts from those specific containers — useful for investigating a single tank's incident history.

title: Critical Alerts — Results
content: Each row shows when the alert occurred, its severity and current status, the tank it came from, and the alert message. Results are sorted newest first.

title: Refill Logs Report
content: Refill Logs Report tracks every LN2 refill across all your sites — who performed it, which tank, when it happened, and whether the LN2 order was received on time.

title: Date From
content: Filter refill records starting from this date — useful for scoping the report to a specific operational period or audit window.

title: Date To
content: Set the upper bound of the refill date range to keep results focused on the period you care about.

title: Status Filter
content: Filter by refill status — Not started, In progress, or Done — to track which refills have been completed and which are still pending.

title: Tank Codes Filter
content: Select specific tanks to view only their refill history — useful for auditing a single container's complete maintenance record.

title: Refill Logs — Results
content: Each row captures a complete refill event — the tank, branch, who performed the refill, the date and time, the reservoir used, and the LN2 order and receipt dates.

title: Activity Logs
content: Activity Logs give admins and managers a complete audit trail — every user action, system event, and automated trigger is recorded here for accountability and compliance.

title: Date From
content: Restrict the audit trail to events that occurred on or after this date.

title: Date To
content: Set the upper end of your audit window. Together with Date From, this scopes the log to a precise time period.

title: Actions Filter
content: Select one or more action types — such as user logins, alert acknowledgements, or refill detections — to filter the log down to the specific events you need.

title: Outcome Filter
content: Filter by outcome — success, failure, or partial — to quickly surface failed operations or partially completed actions that may need follow-up.

title: Actor Type Filter
content: Distinguish between actions taken by a human user and those triggered by automated system processes, scheduled jobs, or external webhooks.

title: Search
content: Type a keyword and press Enter to search across action names, actor names, targets, and outcomes. Use this to track a specific user's activity or find a particular event.

title: Activity Logs — Results
content: Each row shows the action performed, who triggered it, what it affected, the outcome, and a metadata summary with the key details of that event.

title: Download Your Report
content: Once you've filtered and reviewed the data on screen, click Download CSV to export the full result set for offline analysis or compliance records.
